notes: GAAP. Governmental funds only (no enterprise/proprietary funds in the statements; fiduciary/custodial funds skipped). Receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column of the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (p6); 'Leases' 67,842,891 under Other Financing Sources recorded as debt_proceeds. Roll-forward: 232,580,573 + 435,674,953 - 475,934,173 + 16,463,915 - 16,463,915 + 67,842,891 = 260,164,244 (ties). ending_cash = Cash and pooled investments from the governmental funds Balance Sheet (p5); restricted assets 45,022,894 not included. Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position (p3), single Governmental Activities column; balances. Statement 'Miscellaneous' taxes 8,585,294 (General 2,706,636 + Tourism 'Other' 5,878,658) kept as other taxes; Tourism 'Other' taxes line in detail is Miscellaneous Tax per the Douglas County ruling. Detail present in the trim: General Fund budget-and-actual (pp7-8, budget basis, department lines with no object breakdown), Road Fund (p9), Health Center Fund (p10), Douglas County Justice Center Fund (p11) budget schedules, and the Combining Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Non-Major Governmental Funds (pp12-14), recorded per individual fund column (funds with all-zero columns, e.g. Escrow Liability, Law Enforcement, CAA, have no lines). Not in the trim: the Combining Balance Sheet - Non-Major Governmental Funds (report pp82-84) and the Schedule of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Budget and Actual - Individual Funds (report pp88-103, 16 pages); the trim jumps from report p87 to the statistical section (pp135-139), so those individual nonmajor budget schedules are cut off; nonmajor detail therefore comes from the GAAP combining statement. Pages 15-19 are statistical schedules (FTEs, operating indicators) with no money data used. Budget-basis General Fund totals (revenue 329,504,161; expenditures 307,821,373) differ from GAAP by design. Read pages 1-19 of 19
